scope:
Independent neutral-column and incoming-packet screen from saved plume outputs.
No source/hydrodynamic rerun. Run python gas_assessment.py --root /path/to/website.
Dependencies numpy/scipy; output gas-assessment.json next to this script by default.
Subjective intervals below are explicit conditional judgments, not measured posteriors.

column_kernel.formula: Gamma(w)=integral_0^min(65,4/w²) x exp(-x) B(w sqrt(x)) dx, B(a)=.5−1/a−(1+a²)/a² log|1−a|,0<a<2.
column_kernel.interpretation: Instantaneous uniform spherical wall mass source; diffuse cosine directions,flux-Maxwell speeds,no collisions,first wallhitcaptured. Numerical peak guardedby0.3%; pastshotbound usesmin(3.26,8/w^4).

dust_acceptance_rows.scope: Conservative single-grain energy criterion; not a crater model or proof that one affected packet spoils a whole pulse. Smaller grains require aggregate heat test.

uncertainty.classification: Subjective conditional uncertainty, not simulation-derived probability; distributional shape and independence are analyst judgments.

acceptance.scope: Engineering screening allocations. Actual implosion/packet tolerances are not specified or validated.

thermal_source_multiplier.rationale: Broad conditional source range covers accommodation belowunity and strong rough/nanoparticle enhancement. Assumes saved thermal profile remains representative; excludes impact-driven material ejection.

effective_condensing_probability_per_wal.rationale: Purpose-built cool collecting surfaces; unmeasured sticking/reemission/port behavior. Neutral capture must be designed, not assumed instantaneous.

atomic_interaction_cross_section_m2.rationale: Order-of-magnitude atomic collision screen only. Replace with charge/species/energy-resolved data; not fitted to this beam.

retained_gas_collision_energy_fraction.rationale: Macroscopic packet heat partition not simulated. Complete retention1 is also reported as a bounding screen.

uncertainty.distribution: Source multiplier: median1, split normal inlog with10/90percentiles. Capture: split logit-normal median.5. Crosssection: lognormal. Energyretention:logit-normal. Independent draws, seed3102026,200000samples.
uncertainty.explicit_limits: These80% intervals do not include nonthermal sputter/dust/plasma loads or unknown spatialhotspots. No credible interval for total contamination is defensible from currentdata.

acceptance_source_scales.scope: Steady uniform source only. Source limits scale with capture probability and gas speed; burst and local-port columns need direct integration.

limitations: Thermal data are saved64-grid receiver temperatures; no rerun or totalerosion claim.
1/s scaling of source and periodic bound is a molecular-flow renewal screen. Actual returned gas can cool, change species and stick differently.
Molecular and atom columns aredistinct: atom-count opticaldepth is a conservative additiveinteraction proxy, not a C2/C3 crosssection model.
Surface collisions deposit heat in a stopping layer; bulk specificenergy is necessary but insufficient to ruleout surfaceablation or beam halo.
Crosssection-based dilute-neutral tests do not describe chargedplasma collective fields or micron dust.
No manufacturing energy or cost coefficient is assumed.1000launchers do notdivide theambientcolumn perpacket.
